name: Body weight
why_it_matters: Weight loss in flight usually means too few calories, which speeds up muscle and bone loss.
how_to_measure: Same scale (or mass-measurement device) each morning, before breakfast.

name: HRV
why_it_matters: Heart rate variability falls with stress, poor sleep, overtraining and illness.
how_to_measure: Overnight average from a wearable, or a 1-minute morning reading lying down.

name: Grip strength
why_it_matters: A quick proxy for whole-body muscle strength, which declines without loading.
how_to_measure: Hand dynamometer, dominant hand, best of three.
